answer: What keeps this honest is alumni association hash with university attestation, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One meadow of signal, one hollow of cost, one comet of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
